theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), M ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable (m + 1) M → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∑ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (ξ x) α) ^ 2 = 1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T ω = tauAction (m + 1) M θ ξ ω) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∃ τ : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl P, Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)) ∧ (ξ x = simpleNVector τ ∨ ξ x = -simpleNVector τ)
